Near Owen Sound; marketed as a ready-to-build rural residential lot.
Vacant building lot with installed laneway; not agricultural land evidence.
Residential lot; not agricultural productivity evidence.
Established community lot with landscaping and access; minor site preparation is not separately valued.
Treed building lot; listing expired December 2025 and is retained as a recent asking-price observation.
Wooded 2.3-acre building lot near Wiarton; residential-lot pricing context.
Area calculated from published 200.41 ft by 437.12 ft dimensions; rocky wooded lot.
Vacant rural building lot between Meaford, Owen Sound and Markdale.
Saugeen River frontage and wooded edges; waterfront/recreation premium may be present.
Three-acre building lot east of Hanover; residential-lot context.
Scenic vacant parcel near Durham; rural residential/building-lot market.
4.25 acres with a 28 x 60 ft steel workshop; retained as improved-property context and excluded from bare/whole-land median.
Flat vacant land with approved building site; listing page describes 9.317 acres.
Mixed open space, mature trees, pond and tapped maple; not a pure tillable-cropland observation.
Hardwood bush and rural surroundings; approved permits add development value but no dwelling is included.
Approximately 8 acres with river, rugged hill and no survey; restricted natural-environment context. Sale status shown by public listing page.
Small as-is home, well and septic included; retained as improved-property context and excluded from bare/whole-land median.
Farm listing with three-bedroom dwelling; retained as improved-property context only.
Ten-acre recreational/woodland property with two older storage sheds; sheds are minor and not separately adjusted.
Vacant land with semi-cleared building site and mature trees; not a tillable-land value observation.
Hardwood forest; recreational/maple potential but access and development constraints make this a weak ARC comparator.
Public brokerage index describes 12.4 acres of forested vacant land. Individual listing page was not retained; use as a lower-confidence whole-property asking-price observation.
Search result reported 13.5 acres and CAD 58,700, but the listing is no longer active and the public page cannot currently be re-opened; excluded pending verification.
Approximately 20 acres hardwood and mixed bush; asking-price observation for mixed/wooded rural land, not prime tillable land.
Hardwood forest, maple grove, orchard and seasonal creeks; valid development permit creates a site-specific value premium.
Large pond and private driveway; vacant land with site-specific water/recreation characteristics.
Three-acre pond, approximately 16 acres planted in corn, well and former building site; whole-property price retained with site features disclosed.
Mature woodlands and Beaver Valley recreation/landscape premium; likely not representative of ordinary farm land.
Large mixed rural parcel with significant environmental and wetland constraints.
Approximately 40 workable acres and mixed bush; vacant farm-scale land with no dwelling described.
Large vacant parcel bordering Grey County Forest; mixed rural/recreational rather than measured tillable-land value.
Listing describes a 50+ acre treed parcel. Fifty acres is used as a conservative lower-bound area, so the derived price per hectare is an upper-bound estimate.
Public brokerage index describes 52 acres of vacant mixed natural land near Flesherton. Individual listing page was not retained; lower-confidence observation.
Vacant farm-scale parcel; listing description does not state productive/tillable area, so total-hectare price is used only.
Farm with dwelling, two barns, sheds and wind-turbine income; raw $/ha is retained as improved context only.
Approximately 40 tillable acres, condemned house and outbuildings; raw $/ha is not bare-land evidence.
Approximately 125 acres productive, but prominent intersection and future development potential create a strategic premium; excluded from ordinary farm curve.
Farm with 40 acres hay, pasture, shed and hobby barn; raw $/ha retained as improved-property context only.

land_market.planning_curve_basis: The 5–10 ha value is anchored to the 2024 Grey County survey benchmark converted from CAD 19,000 per tillable acre. Other values remain explicit fallback sensitivities and are not used when a parcel-size band has sufficient local observations.
notes: Survey benchmarks per tillable acre are not silently treated as whole-parcel sale prices.
Farm properties with dwellings or outbuildings require improvement separation before entering the parcel curve.
The importer accepts manually verified lawful observations; no REALTOR.ca scraping is used.
